question: To what extent has the world's GDP per capita grown between 2000 and 2020?
query: SELECT      AVG(CASE WHEN year = 2000 THEN gdp_per_capita END) AS avg_gdp_2000,     AVG(CASE WHEN year = 2020 THEN gdp_per_capita END) AS avg_gdp_2020,     ((AVG(CASE WHEN year = 2020 THEN gdp_per_capita END) - AVG(CASE WHEN year = 2000 THEN gdp_per_capita END)) / AVG(CASE WHEN year = 2000 THEN gdp_per_capita END)) * 100 AS growth_rate FROM global_development_indicators WHERE year IN (2000, 2020) LIMIT 50;
